data.one_liner: A command pattern implementation for Dart and Flutter using result_dart.
data.what_it_does: Encapsulates actions into commands with built-in state management for idle, running, success, failure, and cancellation states. It integrates with result_dart to handle operations and supports listening via ValueListenableBuilder or listeners.
use_when: You want to encapsulate asynchronous actions and manage their execution lifecycle.
You need built-in state tracking (running, success, failure, cancelled) for UI buttons or components.
You use result_dart and want structured command handling.
avoid_when: You prefer global state architectures like BLoC or Riverpod for complex application-wide state.
Your project does not use the result_dart package.
strengths: Clean encapsulation of command lifecycle and state.
Built-in support for cancellation and timeouts.
Cached success and failure states to prevent unnecessary UI flickering.
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the result_dart package.
Not a full architectural framework on its own for complex global states.
data.setup_notes: Add result_command and result_dart to pubspec.yaml dependencies.
